schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID IN (SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES WHERE SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31') AND PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES WHERE NOT SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31')
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID IN (SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES WHERE SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31') AND PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES WHERE NOT SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31')
counterexample:
INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME) VALUES (1, 'Product A'), (2, 'Product B');
INSERT INTO SALES (PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, SALE_DATE, QUANTITY, PRICE) VALUES (1, 1, 1, '2019-01-01', 1, 100), (1, 1, 1, '2019-04-01', 1, 100), (2, 1, 1, '2019-03-31', 1, 100);
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent. Q1 selects products whose all sales occurred strictly between 2019-01-01 and 2019-03-31 (inclusive of both dates). Q2 selects products that have at least one sale in that date range and no sales outside that date range. These conditions are not equivalent.
counterexample_dsp: A product with a sale on 2019-01-01 and another on 2019-04-01 will be excluded by Q1 but included by Q2. A product with a sale only on 2019-03-31 will be included by Q1 but excluded by Q2.
